div.head: Leis Wl 37.3
div.ab: E si alcun jethed les chatels fors de la nef senz busun, sil rendet.
Quodsi aliter actum fuerit, reddet dampnum qui intulit.
E si alcun jethed les chatels fors de la nef senz busun, sil rendet.
37, 3. Wenn jedoch einer die Werthstücke ohne Noth aus dem Schiffe wirft, so ersetze er es.
37, 3. If, however, someone throws the articles of value out of the ship without necessity, he shall make it good.
And if anyone casts the goods out of the ship needlessly, he shall pay compensation for them.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 270–271 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 515, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: iot. Io; MA. alters to jetted
Wenn der Reinigungseid misslingt, so liegt vermutlich Missetat ohne Absicht (s. d. Gl 5) vor; Busse und Strafe unterbleiben
If the oath of purgation fails, the case is presumably one of misdeed without intent (see that word in Gl 5); compensation and penalty are not incurred
